Finally, another update for Paradise! It only took like... over a year to get this one out... again... but this one's definitely worth the wait. We don't have a fancy name this time though, so we're simply calling it the...

# August 2026 Update

This update is packed with bug fixes and improvements. So much in fact that the entire changelog is just a single commit. Definitely not the way to go in modern day software engineering, but so much has changed that going through all the changes to recreate a proper Git history would've taken probably another year or so.

Let's highlight some of the big changes. A lot of the **bug fixes** were provided by @NekoSuneVR in their [fork](https://github.com/NekoSuneVR/NekoNexus) of Paradise, as well as the replacement implementation of Photon. This enables the Paradise server to be hosted **completely** on any platform of your choice, instead of the Realtime servers being limited to Windows while only the Web Services could be hosted anywhere.

Dropping Photon also made it possible to provide **Docker images** of both the Web Services and the Realtime servers, making hosting your own server easier than ever. Check out [`festivaldev/paradise-ws`](https://github.com/orgs/festivaldev/packages/container/package/paradise-ws) and [`festivaldev/paradise-realtime`](https://github.com/orgs/festivaldev/packages/container/package/paradise-realtime)

If you're hosting a server, there is a **breaking change**: The config file for the Web Services has been renamed to [`paradise.yml`](packages/ws/paradise_SAMPLE.yml) while the Realtime config is now called [`paradise-realtime.yml`](packages/realtime/Paradise.Realtime/paradise-realtime_SAMPLE.yml). Please check the linked sample files for added or removed keys if you run into issues.

The database schema also changed, but there's a migration for that. Simply import [`packages/ws/src/seed/migrations/migration.sql`](packages/ws/src/seed/migrations/migration.sql) to update your schema, but be sure to **make a backup first**!

In other news: The installer now includes additional game resources (which it didn't before for some reason), macOS is now supported even after 10.15, and our GUI additions in the client has been reworked completely to be more dynamic and allow for multiple popups to be displayed at the same time.

This is just a handful of changes in this update. For more information, please see the changelog:

**Full Changelog**: [v2.1.2...v2.2.0.rc-1](../../compare/v2.1.2...v2.2.0-rc.1)

Thank you to each and everyone for your ongoing patience, and especially to those who have contributed to Paradise in any way! <3

Next up will be a completely new wiki that is no longer bound to the limits of GitHub, followed by a website where you can find information about Paradise, browse servers and games, see your statistics, etc.
